title: Sm2+ doped strontium pentaborate chloride for dual-modal temperature imaging
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12092-12099
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09629D, Paper

Zhongmin Cao, Zhicheng Liao, Qian Zhang, Li Li, Xianju Zhou, Sha Jiang, Guangxin Xie, Yonghu Chen, Min Yin, Xiantao Wei
A Sm2+-doped Sr2B5O9Cl multimodal thermometry material was successfully synthesized, and its application potential in temperature sensing and thermal imaging was systematically investigated.
